planets.name: Mira-27
planets.headline: I need a little time before I know what I think.
planets.about: I keep notes from walks and usually turn them into questions, not conclusions. I would enjoy reading something you changed your mind about recently.
planets.conversationStarter: What idea stayed with you longer than you expected?
planets.visualDirection: Deep indigo, faint atmosphere, no ring

planets.name: Iora-42
planets.headline: The small check-ins matter to me.
planets.about: I like conversations that can be ordinary: a recipe that failed, a good bus ride, or how your week really went. I listen carefully and appreciate the same in return.
planets.conversationStarter: What is one small thing that made this week easier?
planets.visualDirection: Warm coral with a soft amber glow

planets.name: Veyr-31
planets.headline: Some places feel like home only after you leave.
planets.about: I have moved enough to collect favorite corners in several cities. These days I am curious about the routines people build when everything around them changes.
planets.conversationStarter: Which place surprised you by feeling familiar?
planets.visualDirection: Slate blue, thin silver ring, gentle rotation

planets.name: Celyn-58
planets.headline: I build little things to solve annoyances I can name.
planets.about: I enjoy talking about how a product feels after the demo is over. I am prototyping a simpler way to keep track of ideas, and I would rather hear a sharp question than polite praise.
planets.conversationStarter: What is a tiny tool you wish existed?
planets.visualDirection: Electric cyan highlights on a dark graphite surface

planets.name: Sora-46
planets.headline: I remember a book by the person who handed it to me.
planets.about: I read slowly and often stop for a single sentence. Recent favorites are stories about ordinary people making slightly brave choices. Recommendations are welcome, including books you did not finish.
planets.conversationStarter: Which book did you put down but still think about?
planets.visualDirection: Muted burgundy, paper-gold halo, subtle grain

planets.name: Nalo-19
planets.headline: Movement helps me hear my own thoughts.
planets.about: I am learning to balance training with enough rest. I love practical routines people can actually keep, especially when life gets busy. No performance goals required to talk here.
planets.conversationStarter: What kind of movement leaves you feeling better afterward?
planets.visualDirection: Sea green with a quiet, breathable atmosphere

planets.name: Elyn-73
planets.headline: I take pictures of things people walk past.
planets.about: Most of my photos are windows, reflections, and the last light in a room. I like hearing what someone else notices in the same image; it is usually different from what I saw.
planets.conversationStarter: What detail caught your eye today?
planets.visualDirection: Lavender and muted rose with a photographic light band

planets.name: Oren-24
planets.headline: I like following a big question back to everyday life.
planets.about: I am interested in why a street has three empty shops and one busy bakery. I ask more questions than I answer, and I value good-faith disagreement with concrete examples.
planets.conversationStarter: What everyday price or rule would you like someone to explain?
planets.visualDirection: Copper and midnight blue, restrained orbital lines

signals.text: I used to think changing my mind meant I had missed something. Lately it feels more like I finally noticed it. What changed your mind this year?
A friend brought soup over and stayed for ten minutes. It was exactly enough. What small gesture has stayed with you?
The best feature in a tool I tried this week was a button that let me leave without losing my place. What tiny design decision have you appreciated lately?
I photographed the same corner at 8 a.m. and 6 p.m. It looked like two different places. What changes a familiar scene for you?
